axes.name: pointer_scope_and_initialization
axes.rationale: The baseline pointer/value form is best, while deleting the pointer or value worsens codegen. Compare the target-like per-iteration pointer lifetime in the nested block and declaration-time pointer initialization; these are distinct source lifetime/initialization shapes with identical MapB binding and loop semantics.

promotion: NONE: independent rebuild and recipe review required
